changes: A program with a protected part stays open: SteelSeries GG no longer goes down with its audio router Sonar
RTSS stays open through a session, so the overlay, frame cap and frame-rate record keep working
Programs whose code runs inside other programs (Windhawk) are no longer stopped - stopping them crashed others
The session monitor checks in milliseconds instead of 2.6 seconds per check
Comparisons set aside rounds where the game changed mode on its own, and measure a lost round again
The hitch count is no longer confused by frame generation
Network quality (Lab): finds the game's own server, IPv6 included, and measures to the last router when the server ignores ping
Fewer false 'left behind' reports after a session: late helpers and services Windows stops on its own
Two more privacy options: no licence validation ticket sent online, online speech recognition off
